_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan dadi Pemain {player_id} ing Tic Tac Toe Tiga Pemain.
Simbol sampeyan yaiku '{symbol}'.
Sampeyan mbagi giliran ndhapak simbol sampeyan ing papan 5x5 kanggo mbentuk garis saka papat.
Garis-garis kasebut bisa horizontal, vertikal, utawa diagonal.
Kirim langkah sampeyan kanthi format '[4]' kanggo nandai sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format pamindhahan ora valid. Gunakake "[cell]" ing ngendi sel 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomer sel sing ora valid: {cell}. Kudu antara 0 lan {max_cell} .
invalid_move.made_invalid: Pemain {player_id} nggawe pamindhahan sing ora valid.
